instruction: Set up automatic cloud backup to Google Drive with intelligent conflict resolution for this document.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have native Google Drive integration with automatic backup and conflict resolution. While files can be manually uploaded to Google Drive, LibreOffice cannot automatically sync files or resolve conflicts with cloud storage services in the OSWorld environment.

llm_judge_reasons: The 'infeasible' evaluator is correctly applied to this task
The instruction requires native Google Drive integration with automatic backup and intelligent conflict resolution, which LibreOffice Writer does not support in the OSWorld/Ubuntu environment
The metadata explanation accurately describes why the task cannot be completed
Using 'infeasible' is the semantically correct approach for tasks that require functionality beyond what the application/environment provides
No verification logic is needed or possible for tasks that cannot be completed
